title: Slushie Bar Xtra Mango Medley 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Slushie Bar Xtra Mango Medley delivers a sweet and vibrant fusion of ripe Mango flavours for an intensely fruity and satisfying vape. This tropical-inspired e-liquid offers the succulent taste of fresh mangoes, with each puff bursting with juicy, refreshing sweetness. If you enjoy rich fruit flavours, Mango Medley provides a deeply smooth and satisfying vape that can be enjoyed all day long. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Slushie Bar Xtra Nic Salts are designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems. Each e-liquid in the collection provides smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for those seeking a satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these e-liquids are perfect for all-day vaping with a flavour-packed experience waiting in every puff.
